newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish BGZ bank gets approval for Moscow office.
newsitem.headline: Polish BGZ bank gets approval for Moscow office.

text.p: Poland's large cooperative bank Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA (BGZ) has got an approval from the Russian central bank to open an office in Moscow, BGZ said on Friday.
It said in a statement that the office of the bank, specialising in food-related businesses, would initially analyse the Russian banking market and look for a partner for mutual operations in Russia.
"The opening of BGZ's office in Moscow is connected to the implementation of its eastern strategy, which provides for increasing activities in the region," the statement said. @
Last year BGZ said it wanted to create a Polish-Russian bank. Its officials were not immediately available for comment.
